authority.why_not_mechanical: the source was a live prompt rather than a file, so the mechanical extraction EQ1 and EQ2 used was not available; the limitation is disclosed rather than papered over

gates.OD-011_non_vacuity: PASS, 4 of 4, proven on synthetic curves before any measurement existed
gates.sealed_asset_guard: PASS, 0 lens reads, 0 references to T, 0 imports of the instrument under test
gates.harness_positive_control: PASS, 0.9862 with lcb 0.9523 against a required 0.90

measurement.model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, 28 transformer layers, the EQ2 positive control
measurement.eval_set: the pre-existing multihop set; no item was authored

outcome.why_not: the registration states a verdict means nothing until the structural gates pass, and the PREFIX integrity gate did not pass

two_defects_found.implementation: the clean baseline was measured in a batch-of-one forward and every patched value in a batch-of-48 forward, putting a constant offset of about 0.0138 into every restoration value. The PREFIX gate caught it, which is the part of the design that worked as intended
two_defects_found.registration: the estimand cannot separate movement toward the donor's answer from generic disruption of the recipient's, and the single global ceiling imports the READOUT scale into a BRIDGE test. Both are mine
two_defects_found.neither_is_repaired_here: repairing either after seeing the curve would move the registered text toward the data

reported_only.note: the model produces the labelled target as its top-1 for about a third of the admissible multihop items; EQ2 never established this number. No criterion was adjusted from it

standing_rules_inherited_and_in_force: OD-001 the ceiling is measured in actively used GPU-hours
OD-011 a check must carry a demonstrated failing case, or it counts as not implemented
OD-013 one variable at a time
OD-017 registered text versus implementation conformance, compared on live values

what_this_phase_did_establish.one_thing_only: that the patching harness moves what it claims to move, at 0.9862 with a lower bound of 0.9523
what_this_phase_did_establish.why_it_is_worth_recording: no passing positive control had been obtained anywhere in Study 5 before this. It certifies an INSTRUMENT and nothing else
what_this_phase_did_establish.what_it_does_not_establish: nothing about whether the model computes an intermediate, nothing about J, nothing about the paper, nothing about T

claim_ceiling: P-0 is item-validity verification. No state it can reach is a scientific result, and this state is a halt rather than a determination.
